Smart thinking. A sharp blade's no help if you get knocked off your feet! So, let's start at the deck: boots. Solid footing anchors every traveler. Head to the leatherworker's bench to craft a pair of sturdy boots.

Stitch 'em tight!

Show me your handiwork when it's done.
